## About This Site
vishalhingolauthor.com is the official website of Vishal Hingol — Indian author, mindset coach, and manifestation educator based in Ahmedabad, Gujarat. Author of 17+ books spanning Visionary Fiction, Mindset & Self-Help, Manifestation & Journals, and AI & Business.
